candidate: Folsomia candida spread through 24 experimental habitat networks

publication.citation: Rayfield et al. (2023), Spread of networked populations is determined by the interplay between dispersal behavior and habitat configuration

published_aggregate_evidence.manual_lower_bound_rule: Only visibly separated published markers are counted. No point coordinates, fitted values, response table, supporting spreadsheet, or model-result table is digitized or opened.

calibration_events.basis: Figure S10 experiment panel visibly contains at least ten non-source node first-colonization markers at Day <= 7.

calibration_non_events.basis: Figure S10 visibly contains at least forty nodes with first colonization after Day 5; the documented maximum five-day photography gap guarantees at least one prior observed-zero risk row with target Day <= 7 for each.

heldout_events.basis: Figure S10 visibly contains at least ten non-source node first-colonization markers after Day 7.

heldout_non_events.basis: Figure S10 visibly contains at least forty nodes with first colonization after Day 12; the documented maximum five-day photography gap guarantees at least one observed-zero risk row with target Day > 7 for each.

heldout_outer_units_with_both_classes.basis: The experiment panel of main Figure 2 visibly contains at least eight physical networks reaching full occupancy after Day 12; each therefore has a post-Day-7 event and, under the maximum five-day photography gap, a post-Day-7 non-event.

heldout_outer_units_with_rows.basis: All 24 experiment points in main Figure 2 reach full occupancy after Day 7, so every closed-registry physical network has at least one post-Day-7 at-risk event row.

pre_response_allowed: published aggregate Figure 2 and Figure S10
pre_response_forbidden: any archive member or mirror containing row-level experimental population sizes
any fitted or reconstructed node-level response values

node_geometry.complete_endpoint_geometry: distToSource is the author-released minimum corridor distance from fixed inoculation source node 5 to every focal node in every closed-registry physical landscape

response_semantics.event: first observation with released automated image count N > 0 for a non-source node
response_semantics.non_event: an observation with released automated image count N == 0 while the node has never previously been observed with N > 0
response_semantics.zero_boundary: observed zero in a repeated photograph, not latent biological absence
response_semantics.initial_state: at Day 0 exactly ten F. candida were placed in source node 5 and all other nodes were empty
response_semantics.observation_frequency: 97 photography days over 182 days; typically every 1-2 days and maximum gap five days
response_semantics.image_validation: automated estimates were compared with manual counts in 30 images; r=0.93 and R2=0.86; underestimation was reported particularly at high abundance

temporal_split.calibration_rule: at-risk transition rows whose target observation Day <= 7
temporal_split.heldout_rule: at-risk transition rows whose target observation Day > 7
temporal_split.fit_policy: fit once on calibration rows only; never refit on heldout outcomes

count_gate.failure_action: write immutable non-estimable result with zero fits and zero heldout scores

process_source.entry_boundary: only the declared Day-0 inoculation of ten individuals into node 5
process_source.network_boundary: vial lids closed except during photography; nonhabitable Tygon corridors are the only movement links
process_source.network_design: 10 fixed nodes and 20 links; eight lattice, eight partially rewired, and eight random physical networks

world_scale.distance_units: mm of author-released minimum corridor path from source node 5
world_scale.kernel_basis: published b=-0.043 +/- 0.007; frozen mean plus/minus one and two reported standard errors

layer_a_rules.world_definition: five response-independent negative-exponential dispersal-kernel worlds over fixed-source corridor distance
layer_a_rules.world_filtering: none; a first-positive observation cannot falsify a nonzero stochastic-support world

comparators.baseline: frozen strong random-forest learner with conventional temporal, node, network, mean-kernel, and lagged spread-state predictors
comparators.augmented: the identical frozen learner and identical conventional predictors plus the unchanged ten-column Layer-B block

preprocessing_model_fit.missing_value_policy: no imputation; fail closed on any nonfinite predictor or released count
